plot: On a foggy Saturday morning a beeping box with only a 'B' on its label falls onto the podium; Bolt forbids opening it until the owner is found, Pip reads 'OPEN AT ZERO' from the raised Truth Press, Grumpy's towing and Turbo's shake only make the countdown faster, and secretive Bertha seems to be the owner, until Bolt reads the smudge as 'BOLT': it is his own birthday cake from Bertha, which he forgot; lesson: good surprises are worth waiting for; then a second box starts beeping.

script.title: What's BEEPING in the Mystery Box? 📦⏰ Cartoon Cars
script.description: A beeping box falls out of the fog with only one letter on its label: B. Inspector Bolt says nobody opens it until they find the owner, but the countdown keeps getting faster. Good surprises are worth waiting for! Inspector Bolt #10

beats.say: Whoa! A box just fell out of the fog! And it's BEEPING!
Beep, beep, beep! What is inside that box?
It was a foggy Saturday morning in Wheelburg.
Boxes don't beep. Boxes sit quietly. This box is rude.
Ooh! Maybe it's a present! I love presents!
Nobody touch that box, please. Procedure.
A box we don't own stays closed. First, we find its owner.
Aww! But I really, really want to peek inside!
Bolt rolled closer. There was a paper label on top.
The fog made the ink run. I can only read one letter.
Oh! Bolt, sweetie, what day is it today?
Saturday. A normal day. Nothing special at all.
Hee hee! Nothing special. Right. Of course.
B is for Best! So the box is mine, obviously!
Turbo, your name starts with T.
T is for Totally the best! Still counts!
B is for Bother. And that box is a big bother.
Maybe it's a baby dragon! A tiny, friendly one!
Or a basket of blueberry buns! Mmm!
Everyone guessed something different. Nobody guessed right.
Then the beeping got faster. Beep-beep-beep-beep!
Look! There's tiny writing on the side! But I can't reach it!
The Truth Press can lift you up, Pip. Hop on.
Going up, up, up! Wheee!
It says... OPEN AT ZERO!
Zero? Zero what? Zero minutes? Zero cookies?
It's a countdown. When the beeps stop, the box opens itself.
Then we must find the owner fast, or they miss the surprise!
Pip slid back down. The box kept beeping.
Procedure. We ask every car whose name starts with B.
Bertha starts with B! Bertha, is this box yours?
Mine? Oh, no, no, no. It is not for me.
She's wiggling. Bertha always wiggles when she keeps a secret.
I am NOT wiggling! I am... dancing! La la la!
Everyone laughed. Then Bertha zoomed away into the fog.
Where is she going? The box is still beeping!
I'll sing it a lullaby. Sleepy boxes beep slower!
Pip sang her softest song. The box beeped right along.
It's beeping to the music! That's not slower at all!
Fine. I'll tow it to the Lost and Found myself.
Grumpy lifted his hook. The box beeped right in his ear.
Aaah! Too loud! Too beepy! I give up!
My turn! I'll give it one shake and guess what's inside!
Turbo, no! Shaking is not procedure!
Too late. Turbo gave the box one tiny wiggle.
Uh-oh! It got faster! I made it faster!
Listen. Something inside goes squish. Soft and squishy.
Soft and squishy. Interesting. Very interesting indeed.
Squishy? Maybe it's a beeping pillow! For racing naps!
Unlikely, Turbo. Racing naps are not a thing.
Squishy things are the worst. Like puddles. And hugs.
Just then, Bertha came puffing back out of the fog.
Is it still closed? Oh, thank goodness! Nobody opened it?
Bertha. You know something about this box. Please tell us.
I can't! It's a secret! A really good secret!
Only ten beeps left! We have to find the owner now!
Let's think. A B name. A secret. Something soft and sweet.
And Bertha asked you what day it is. Twice.
She did. And I said nothing special. Hmm.
Nine beeps! Eight beeps! Somebody think faster!
Bolt looked at the smudgy label one more time.
Wait. After the B, there's an O. And an L.
B... O... L... T? BOLT! The box is for YOU!
For me? But who would send a box to me?
I would! Because today is your birthday, silly! You forgot!
My birthday? I solve every mystery... except my own calendar.
I ordered your cake. It fell off my roof in the fog.
I drove back to the bakery to fetch the candles.
So you weren't hiding a secret. You were hiding HIS cake.
And I shook your birthday cake. Sorry, Bolt!
Apology accepted, Turbo. It's still beeping, so it's still fine.
Bertha, thank you. Nobody remembers my birthday. Not even me.
That's what friends are for, Inspector!
Everyone counted the last beeps together. Three... two... one...
Pop! The box opened, and out came a giant birthday cake!
Happy birthday, Inspector Bolt!
Thank you, friends. This is the best surprise ever.
Today's lesson. Good surprises are worth waiting for.
I waited. I'm still grumpy. But I want cake.
And Wheelburg shared the cake right there in the fog.
A second box was beeping. But who is this one for?
